subject: Pilot kickoff readiness & performance criteria
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@orchardlabs.com>; Ryan Delgado <ryan@orchardlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff readiness & performance criteria — post-call recap

Hi Samantha / Ryan — thanks again for a productive demo call today. Quick recap and proposal so we have alignment before we lock the POC dates. Please confirm or flag changes.

Call summary (2 min):
- Objective: validate Redwood inference for Orchard Labs’ customer-facing summarization pipeline (1-2 short docs per request, avg 220 tokens output).
- Scope for pilot: end-to-end acceptance test with ~1k sample requests/day, one week of synthetic stress, one week of customer-simulated traffic.

Proposed success criteria (high level):
1) Latency: P95 generation latency <= 350 ms (for 512 token context, avg output 220 tokens).
2) Throughput: sustain 100 reqs/min for sustained 30-minute windows without request queue growth.
3) Cost: average cost/token <= $0.0009 (at the POC billing profile).
4) Quality: human eval on 200 sampled responses — >= 90% rated acceptable by Orchard QA (precision over hallucinations, factuality).

Owners (Redwood):
- Onboarding & infra creds: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.ai)
- Contract/PO/trial billing: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai)
- Technical lead / escalation: me (David Kim) and Grace O'Connor for infra monitoring.

Suggested timeline (tentative):
- Week 0 (prep): exchange sample payloads & test accounts, share SOC2 & network/access checklist (this week).
- Week 1: baseline runs (sanity + 1k requests/day) + collect telemetry.
- Week 2: stress window + quality annotation.
- Week 3: final analysis & go/no-go decision; joint readout.

Attachments: orchard-poc-metrics.xlsx (metrics template), redwood-kpi-template.docx (POC checklist).

Immediate asks for Orchard:
- Confirm sample payloads and expected peak concurrency (can you confirm whether bursts up to 200 reqs/min are expected?).
- Confirm legal/PO owner so Marissa can loop them in for trial paperwork.

If that aligns, we’ll lock a kickoff date (I recommend May 16 start).

Thanks,
David Kim
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: orchard-poc-metrics.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Samantha Park <samantha@orchardlabs.com>

Cc: Ryan Delgado <ryan@orchardlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff readiness & performance criteria — post-call recap

Thanks David — this looks good and aligns with what our product team expects. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Traffic profile: steady-state ~1k requests/day with short bursts up to 180 reqs/min (peak windows ~10–15 minutes). We don't expect sustained 200 reqs/min but can tolerate short spikes.
- Sample payloads: I'll attach a small set (we'll push the full set to the shared Drive link). Expect a mix of short-form inputs (avg 350 tokens input) and a handful of long-form docs.
- Quality rubric: we'll run internal QA on 300 samples; Orchard defines "acceptable" as no factual hallucinations and preserves key entities. We can share the rubric.

Security: to speed things up, please send SOC 2 and encryption-in-transit docs. Also confirm whether you support customer-managed KMS in the private deployment (we may need that for Prod).

We can commit to the May 16 kickoff if Redwood can provide onboarding creds and a simple test account by May 13. Also loop in billing — we'll need a short trial PO (~$5k cap) executed before the pilot.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Park
Head of Product, Orchard Labs
Attachment: orchard-sample-10.json (json)

Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff readiness & performance criteria — refined plan & owners

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the quick confirmations. Below is a concrete evaluation plan and owners that we will run if Orchard agrees. I added a couple of Redwood test specifics so expectations are explicit.

POC evaluation plan (3 weeks):
- Prep (by May 13): exchange full payload set (Orchard -> shared Drive), Redwood to provision API keys + test workspace, share SOC2 brief and network checklist. Owner: Ben (creds) / Marissa (PO).
- Week 1 (May 16–22): Baseline runs — 1k/day steady traffic, collect P50/P95/P99 latency + token counts. We will run with the model variant XLM-3b-q4 (approx cost estimate in template). Success gate: P95 <= 350 ms OR show determinable plan to meet it with minor tuning.
- Week 2 (May 23–29): Stress windows — 10–15 minute bursts up to 180 reqs/min, continuous 30-min ramp tests to validate no queue buildup. Success gate: throughput stability + no failed requests above 0.5%.
- Week 3 (May 30–June 5): Quality annotation — Orchard QA rates 300 samples against rubric. Success gate: >= 90% acceptable. Final joint readout and recommended steps for Prod.

Metrics we will collect (telemetry): P50/P95/P99 latency, tokens per request, GPU utilization, queue depth, cost per token (Redwood invoiced metric), error rate (5xx/4xx), model confidence proxy (logprob heuristics). Template attached: orchard-poc-metrics.xlsx.

Ownership (definitive):
- Redwood infra & keys: Ben Carter — will send keys + test workspace by May 13.
- Billing & PO: Marissa Cole — please confirm contact and whether Orchard can do Net30 PO.
- Monitoring & dashboards: Grace O'Connor — will provision a read-only dashboard for Orchard.
- Technical escalation & SRE support: David Kim.

Next steps (actionable, short):
1) Samantha -> share full payload bundle and QA rubric to the Drive link by May 10.
2) Ben -> send API keys + test workspace by May 13.
3) Marissa -> share trial PO template and DocuSign link (if Orchard prefers e-sign).
4) David/Grace -> schedule first sync for May 17 to review baseline results.

Attachments: orchard-poc-metrics.xlsx, mvp-sample-payloads.json.

If that all looks good I’ll update the HubSpot deal with dates and owners (ORCH-4312).

-David
